main_subject.description: An adult woman with messy shoulder-length brown hair, relaxed slightly bored expression, natural skin texture, and a black choker.

technical_specs.quality: edge-to-edge sharpness, subtle grain, slight noise, chromatic aberration, visible natural pores, unedited texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a raw photoreal 2:3 wide-angle full-body 35mm portrait of an adult woman seated sideways in the passenger seat of an unbranded vintage car. She has messy shoulder-length brown hair, a relaxed slightly bored expression, natural skin texture, a black choker, blank vintage black T-shirt, loose dark denim jeans, and plain white sneakers. Both feet are comfortably on the floor, knees angled naturally together; her left elbow rests on the center console supporting her cheek and right hand rests on her thigh. Shoot from outside the open passenger door, keeping the weathered red metal door frame and wooden dashboard sharply in focus. Use golden-hour backlight, f/11 deep focus, film grain, slight noise and chromatic aberration, no badges, logos, text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, legs-wide pose, named band shirt, Van Halen, logo, watermark, readable text, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, bokeh, blurred background, plastic skin, distorted anatomy
